changes: Fixed farm detection in the channels set with `/channels` — the video, world and schematic channels were configured but nothing was ever recognised, because the old detector only matched the exact `📪 DN: 123` form and only staged suggestions instead of registering farms.

Farm detection now reads the DN from every form people actually use (`DN: 445`, `DN : 445`, `DN=B100`, `dn 100`, `📪 DN : B105`, and a bare `B105` in the message), ignoring anything inside links, dates or times.

A new video post in the video channel now creates the farm straight away, and a world or schematic post updates the matching farm. When a link disagrees with a farm that already has one, nothing is overwritten: it is logged as a conflict and staged for a manager, exactly as before.
Farm detection now reports which bot messages it ignored and which bot ID to add to `FARM_RELAY_BOT_IDS`, instead of silently skipping them.

Added `/ticket ping:<hours>` (and `m.ticket ping <hours>`) for staff: finds every open ticket whose newest staff reply is older than the given number of hours and pings the ticket owner plus the staff member who last replied, with a summary of what was pinged.
The automatic 24-hour ticket sweep now uses the same detection as `/ticket ping`, so it waits for a *staff* reply rather than any message, and both report skipped tickets instead of ignoring them.
